title: Template Studio
lead: A section for pack authors: edit templates and propose changes to the packs repository. The git host decides on merging.

section.title: Section
section.enabledHint: Only people with the “Template author” right and installation administrators see the section.
section.locked: The switch is set by the server environment.

grants.title: “Template author” right
grants.lead: Who can open the section. Installation administrators always have it.
grants.emptyLead: Grant it to a person or an organization group.

grant.title: Grant the “Template author” right
grant.lead: To a person or a whole organization group: new group members get the right automatically.

service.title: Service access
service.lead: An instance-level token for a pack repository: workspaces of people with the Template author right push branches with it, commits are signed by the person. One access per repository.
service.emptyLead: Without it, template authors use their own tokens.
service.removeLead: Workspaces that use it lose access to the repository.
service.addTitle: Service access to a pack repository
service.addLead: The token is stored encrypted and never shown again. Every use is written to the audit log.
service.label: Label
service.tokenHint: https only. Rights as in the pack repository profile: write, pull requests, checks status.
